description: Polish, performance optimization, and final production readiness. This includes: code splitting with React.lazy, image optimization, infinite scroll implementation, keyboard shortcuts, proper meta tags/SEO, final responsive tweaks, and ensuring the complete app matches PRD/TDD requirements.
steps: Implement proper infinite scroll on Movies and TV browse pages using IntersectionObserver - when user scrolls near bottom, automatically load next page. Show a small loading spinner at bottom while loading more.
Add keyboard shortcuts support: Arrow keys for grid navigation, Enter to select, Escape to go back, Space for play/pause in player, F for fullscreen in player. Use useEffect with keydown listeners.
Ensure all route-based code splitting is working with React.lazy() and Suspense with LoadingState fallback for each route
Add proper document title updates on each page (e.g., 'HIJISTREAM - Movies', 'Movie Title - HIJISTREAM')
Add empty states: when Continue Watching is empty show a friendly message, when search returns no results show helpful text
Ensure the Continue Watching section on Home page correctly reads from playerStore/localStorage and displays cards with progress bars
Add a 'Clear Cache' option somewhere accessible (e.g., in footer or settings)
Double-check all colors match the design system: bg-white, text-gray-900 for primary text, text-gray-500 for muted, border-gray-200 for borders, bg-blue-600 for primary buttons
Ensure hover states on all interactive elements: cards scale slightly or border darkens, buttons darken, links underline
Add proper focus-visible styles for keyboard accessibility (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:ring-offset-2)
Final responsive check: ensure no horizontal overflow at any viewport width, proper spacing on mobile
Verify npm run build produces optimized bundle with code splitting (multiple JS chunks)
Test that the app handles API errors gracefully - shows ErrorState with retry button on any failed fetch
acceptance_criteria: Infinite scroll loads more content automatically when scrolling near bottom
Keyboard shortcuts work for navigation and player control
Route-based code splitting produces multiple JS chunks in build output
All pages have appropriate document titles
Continue Watching section reads and displays watch progress correctly
All colors and spacing match the PRD design system exactly
Hover and focus states are present on all interactive elements
No horizontal overflow at any viewport width
Production build succeeds and is optimized
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && npm run build' and confirm exit code 0 with multiple chunks in output
Verify build output shows code splitting (multiple .js files in dist/assets/)
findings: Build succeeds with bun run build. Multiple chunks generated confirming code splitting works. All features implemented: infinite scroll, keyboard shortcuts, document titles, empty states, footer with cache clear, active route highlighting, focus-visible states, smooth scroll CSS, enhanced VideoPlayer event handling, and OG meta tags.
